notes.title: Recent changes
notes.notes:
Dear community,
The following changes to Project RPG have been performed:
[list]
[*] decreased the price to $0.99
[*] decreased the game file size by approximately half, without any loss of content
[*] rewrote the store page and the minimum/recommended hardware specifications
[*] optimized the Steam Cloud synchronization for savegames
[*] disabled a disimproving framerate optimization feature
[*] fixed an issue which does not count any playtime without the use of external software
[*] recreated a video sequence
[*] added automatic in-game healing when the character gets wounded
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.4
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]

- Finally, the main questline has completed development
- Added multiple new map areas 
   - Two new villages 
   - Cave
- Added more side quests
- Minor bug fixes

We are happy to announce that the main questline is completely ready for players to complete. Although that doesn't mean the end of development or early access. There is still a lot we plan to add to the game. New announcement will be posted soon with more information as well as in the dev log thread in our forums.

notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes[/b]

As promised, the update has been added to the build today!

- New map area
- Addition to main quest line
- Minor bug fixes

[b]Next update[/b]

You can expect the next update to be sometime this weekend. The exact day will be posted in the "Dev log" thread in our forums.

In the mean time you can check out The Spirit Underneath on greenlight! The game has completed development and is ready for a full release. If you are interested in seeing the game purchasable on the steam store, vote for it!

notes.notes:
[b]Tomorrow[/b] all players can look forward to a new small update including a new addition to the map, along with new additions to the main storyline quest! Also, check out [b]The Spirit Underneath[/b] on [b]Greenlight[/b] on please vote if you are interested! Note The Spirit Underneath is in a complete state and ready for a full release if greenlit.

notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Big Update
notes.notes:
[b]Patch notes:[/b]

- Added new quest, improved another quest
- New main quest area added
- More main storyline added
- New title and loading screens added!
- Fixed tree cutting error given at beginning of game
- Fixed dialogue issue
- Majour optimization fixes
- Fixed "Missing executable issue" that started a couple days ago (we were unaware of issue until lately

We have fixed many things, aswell as added new things and made some adjustments to the game. Only few quests are available at the moment. Many more coming soon. We hope to get many more added this week, and any new bug fixes and errors we run into. Look forward to a new update within the next couple days with new available quests added to the main storyline, and some side quests aswell!

notes.title: Released: Early Access + Patch News
notes.notes:
Project RPG has been released may 2nd and is now available for purchase in an early access state. Please note the game is in early development stages and we wish to continue the development of Project RPG with the help of the community! If you do not wish to play the unfinished product than please do not purchase the game until if and when the game is in a fully functional and released state. 

Next Patch will be available soon including some bug fixes and extensions to the games current state.
